page_title: RBL 1-5 BAY | RB Leipzig v Bayern Munich 17/01/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' That's all for today as the game is over.
90+5' Bayern Munich have been awarded a corner kick.
90+5' Harry Kane (Bayern Munich) fires a shot at goal from a very promising position outside the penalty area, but it is blocked by a self-sacrificing defender. Now Bayern Munich have a corner.
90+4' Conrad Harder (RB Leipzig) connects with a cross from out wide in the six-yard box, but only plants his header onto the right post.
90+2' A spell of possession for RB Leipzig in an attempt to control the game.
90' The fourth official shows 5 min. of added time.
90' Here is a change. Antonio Nusa is going off and Ole Werner gives the last tactical orders to Andrija Maksimovic (RB Leipzig).
88' 1 - 5 Michael Olise (Bayern Munich) finds the back of the net! He latched on to a sweet pass into the box and fired into the roof of the net.
87' It is time for a substitution. Min-Jae Kim (Bayern Munich) is on for Hiroki Ito.
87' We are about to witness a substitution. Jamal Musiala (Bayern Munich) is replacing Serge Gnabry.

85' 1 - 4 It's a goal! Michael Olise plays a lovely pass into the box and finds Aleksandar Pavlovic (Bayern Munich). He tries his luck from close range and coolly strikes the ball into the back of the net. 1:4.
85' Ole Werner prepares a substitution. Christoph Baumgartner (RB Leipzig) is replaced by Tidiam Gomis.
84' The goal stands! That took a long time for referee Sascha Stegemann to decide. The relieved Bayern Munich players can finally celebrate.
83' The Bayern Munich players celebrate the goal but the referee immediately signals a VAR review. Let's see what happens. Big moment in the game.

82' 1 - 3 It's in the back of the net! Jonathan Tah (Bayern Munich) gets on the scoresheet after converting a chance from the resulting corner kick. He finds himself some space inside the box and plants a perfect header into the top of the net. 1:3.
82' Serge Gnabry (Bayern Munich) reacts well to latch onto a rebound inside the box, but his shot is well blocked. It will be a corner kick for Bayern Munich.
81' Substitution. Tom Bischof did his best and is replaced by Alphonso Davies (Bayern Munich).
81' Ole Werner has decided to substitute Nicolas Seiwald and he is replaced by Ezechiel Banzuzi (RB Leipzig).
81' Romulo Cardoso comes off the pitch to be replaced by Conrad Harder (RB Leipzig).

80' Michael Olise (Bayern Munich) gets inside the box and tries to beat Peter Gulacsi with a measured shot into the left side of the goal, but the keeper is equal to the effort and makes a fine save. Bayern Munich have been awarded a corner kick.
79' Another attempt to send the ball beyond the defence by Yan Diomande (RB Leipzig) is thwarted and cleared to safety.
77' The statistic for corner kicks – 5:6.
75' Joshua Kimmich (Bayern Munich) takes the corner kick but the ball only finds the head of an opponent.

74' Joshua Kimmich (Bayern Munich) takes the free kick from long distance. He sends a nice cross into the box, but his intention is well anticipated by the goalkeeper who comes out to collect the ball.
73' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from RB Leipzig comes to nothing.

72' Yan Diomande (RB Leipzig) has a great chance inside the six-yard box, shoots to the roof of the net, but Manuel Neuer pulls off an exquisite save to deny him. The ball is out of play. RB Leipzig will have a chance to score from a corner.
71' Bayern Munich are ruled offside.
69' The total number of attempts is 13:11.
67' 1 - 2 Harry Kane (Bayern Munich) gets on the end of a perfect cross after one of the defenders fails to clear and strikes the ball inside the left post!
66' David Raum (RB Leipzig) lifts the ball into the box from the corner, but one of the defending players gets there first to head it clear.

65' A neat pass is well received by Romulo Cardoso (RB Leipzig), who is lurking on the edge of the box and strikes the ball towards the roof of the net, but the goalkeeper makes an incredible save to block his shot. The referee signals a corner kick to RB Leipzig.
65' RB Leipzig can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.

64' Nicolas Seiwald (RB Leipzig) has a crack at goal from inside the box, but the defender somehow makes the block to deny him. The ball goes behind for a corner. RB Leipzig will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
63' The possession of the ball – 43:57.
61' The corner from Michael Olise (Bayern Munich) is cleared away by the defence.
61' Peter Gulacsi pulls off a great save to deny Harry Kane (Bayern Munich) who, makes himself some space inside the box and unleashes a quick low drive towards the middle of the goal.
59' Joshua Kimmich (Bayern Munich) takes the corner.
59' Luis Diaz (Bayern Munich) aims for the middle of the goal, but that's an easy job for the goalkeeper. It will take more than that to test him! Bayern Munich have a corner.

58' Michael Olise (Bayern Munich) receives a precise pass in the box and takes the shot early. The ball heads towards the middle of the goal, but Peter Gulacsi shows off his skills and makes a brilliant save to deny him.
57' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Michael Olise (Bayern Munich) comes onto the pitch so that Lennart Karl can be given a rest.
56' Tom Bischof (Bayern Munich) sends in the corner, but fails to find the head of any of his teammates, allowing the defence to clear.
56' The free kick is delivered by Joshua Kimmich (Bayern Munich) but it's not one of his best and is easily cleared. Bayern Munich earn a corner.

55' Xaver Schlager (RB Leipzig) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Sascha Stegemann has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle. A free kick has been awarded to Bayern Munich.
53' Nothing comes of the resulting corner from David Raum (RB Leipzig). The defence is alert and manages to cut it out.
52' David Raum (RB Leipzig) takes the corner but only sends it into a huddle of the defenders and one of them makes a good clearance.
50' 1 - 1 Goal! It's a catastrophic error from the opponent which has gifted a chance to Serge Gnabry (Bayern Munich), who rolls the ball into the back of the net from close range. 1:1.
48' Yan Diomande (RB Leipzig) makes a strong challenge and Sascha Stegemann blows for a foul.
46' Here is a change after the half-time break. Leon Goretzka is replaced by Joshua Kimmich (Bayern Munich).
46' The second half has just started.
45+5' Sascha Stegemann blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.
45+5' It seemed like David Raum (RB Leipzig) was going to take a quick free kick, but instead he is going to send the ball inside the penalty box for his teammates.
45+3' Harry Kane (Bayern Munich) is flagged for offside.
45+2' Hiroki Ito (Bayern Munich) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked.
45' There will be a minimum of 4 min. of added time.
43' Aleksandar Pavlovic (Bayern Munich) wriggles into space and fires the ball from the edge of the area, but one of the defenders is there to block the effort.
41' Luis Diaz (Bayern Munich) was trying to get to the ball but clattered into the legs of the opponent as well. Sascha Stegemann blows his whistle for an infringement.
39' Bayern Munich players are exchanging short passes with one another, waiting for the right moment to beat the opposition's defence.
37' Antonio Nusa (RB Leipzig) sends a weak shot high over the bar from the edge of the box.
36' A mistake by a defender gifts Christoph Baumgartner (RB Leipzig) a chance inside the box, but his wild effort goes high over the bar.
35' Sascha Stegemann has a clear sight and sees a foul from Jonathan Tah (Bayern Munich).
34' Total attempts – 6:3.
32' RB Leipzig are dominating the game at the moment by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. Great harmony between the players.
30' The game is interrupted now, Leon Goretzka (Bayern Munich) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
29' Nicolas Seiwald (RB Leipzig) commits a nasty foul by bringing down his opponent.
27' Tom Bischof (Bayern Munich) sends over a cross, but he can't find any teammate inside the box. Poor delivery.
25' Peter Gulacsi displays his ability to read the game and clears the danger after Serge Gnabry (Bayern Munich) threatened to latch onto a through ball from just outside the box.
24' Antonio Nusa (RB Leipzig) receives a brilliant pass and wastes a big opportunity as his shot from inside the penalty area flies just over the crossbar.
22' Luis Diaz (Bayern Munich) is caught offside!
20' 1 - 0 Romulo Cardoso (RB Leipzig) connects with a pass inside the box and slams home inside the left post. The goalkeeper was helpless.
18' Some great controlled play and passing from RB Leipzig. They are increasing their possession of the ball and trying to open up the opposition's defence to hit them swiftly on the break.
16' Ball possession – 35:65.
14' Lennart Karl (Bayern Munich) breaks past challenges inside the box, but puts too much pace on his pass to Luis Diaz.
13' Yan Diomande (RB Leipzig) makes a driving run into the box but he cannot work any space for a shot.
11' Serge Gnabry (Bayern Munich) decides to speed play up with a short corner kick.

10' Lennart Karl (Bayern Munich) blasts the ball from just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by the defender. Bayern Munich have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
10' Some patient build-up play from Bayern Munich as they look to unlock the defence.
8' Tom Bischof (Bayern Munich) takes the corner with a short pass.
7' Antonio Nusa (RB Leipzig) drives into the box and hits a tremendous shot that, unluckily for him, flashes just wide of the left post.
5' An attempted cross from Lennart Karl (Bayern Munich) is cleared.
4' Romulo Cardoso (RB Leipzig) takes a good first touch from the pass, but mishits his shot low towards the middle of the goal and allows the Manuel Neuer to make a comfortable save.

3' What a miss! Christoph Baumgartner (RB Leipzig) is left standing right in front of goal with only the keeper to beat after a clever pass, but he somehow contrives to toe poke the ball just past the right post.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
The players are on the pitch and RB Leipzig will have the kick-off.
Sascha Stegemann is introduced as the referee for today's match.
